The '''galaxy guzzler''' was a liquidized [[Foodstuff/Legends|meal]] that was considered a favorite of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] locals. Its liquid form was primarily attributed to the high [[Temperature/Legends|temperatures]] caused by Tatooine's [[Binary star system/Legends|twin]] [[Star/Legends|suns]]&mdash;[[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] and [[Tatoo II/Legends|Tatoo II]]&mdash;and was intended to maximize liquid [[Diet/Legends|intake]]. Alongside the [[ruby bliel]] and the [[dusty dazzler]], it was among a variety of liquid foods that could include liquidized [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]] or [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] mixed with [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="FF131" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] guzzler was mentioned in the section "Last Course" of [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 131|issue 131]] of the magazine ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'',<ref name="FF131" /> which was written by [[Iain Lowson]]<ref name="FF Author">{{LinkedIn|url=in/iainlowson|text=Iain Lowson|archivefile=File:IainLowson-LinkedIn.png}}</ref> and published by [[De Agostini]] around [[June 30]], [[2004]].<ref name="Date">{{FFdates|131}}</ref>
